Hi Morgan —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Before we lock dates for staging and production cutover, I want to capture a short preflight checklist for the FinServCorp access controls so CS, Security, and Infra are aligned on acceptance criteria. Attached I’ve included: sso-metadata.xml (IdP metadata we expect), scim-attributes-mapping.xlsx (example mapping), and a one-page redwood-onboard-checklist.pdf.

Quick asks (can you reply inline?):
- Confirm the canonical SAML IdP metadata (entityID, certificate, ACS URLs) and whether you want SP- or IdP-initiated flows as the default for end users.
- Share the SCIM base URL and an admin account we can use in staging for provisioning tests.
- Provide the public IP ranges we should add to the allowlist for token exchange and webhook callbacks.
- Approve the service account name we propose (redwood-fsc-provisioner@finserv.example.com) and whether it will have least-privilege SCIM write + read.
- Acceptance criteria for staging: successful SAML SSO for 5 test users, SCIM create/update/delete for a sandbox group, and successful webhook delivery from your environment to our /webhook/provision endpoint for 48 hours.

Proposed cutover window: 2027-09-07 00:00–04:00 PST (low-traffic). Rollback plan: disable SP config and 30-minute failback to legacy SSO (we’ll coordinate).

If you want, we can take 30 minutes tomorrow to walk the artifacts — I’m free 10:00–12:00 PST.

Thanks —

Thanks, team — added a short security/implementation checklist below. This is focused on hard requirements we need to validate during staging.

Security & technical checklist (Jonas notes):
- SAML
  - Verify entityID and ACS endpoints match what we have in staging. ACS must include both https://staging.redwood.com/saml/acs and the prod host.
  - Certificate algorithm: RSA SHA-256 required. We do not accept SHA-1-signed assertions.
  - Assertion lifetime: recommend <= 5 minutes for authn statements; refresh timeouts 10m for session tokens.
  - Signed/Encrypted assertions: signed required; encryption optional but preferred for PII.

- SCIM provisioning
  - SCIM token: prefer short-lived OAuth2 Bearer token with refresh; if you must use an API key, scope to /Groups and /Users only.
  - Required attributes: userName, active, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work,value], externalId (enterprise ID).
  - Group sync: we will test create/update/delete on a sandbox group named redwood-sandbox-test.
  - Rate limits: we will need at least 20 req/sec sustained for initial bulk sync.

- IP allowlist & webhooks
  - Add 35.197.128.0/19 and 34.68.0.0/16 to staging allowlist; allowlist for prod will be a single static NAT we provide.
  - Webhook retries: we expect 3 retry attempts (exponential backoff). Please forward 2xx codes for success.

- Service account & org policy
  - Recommended service account name: redwood-fsc-provisioner@finserv.example.com (per Marissa). It should have least privilege: SCIM write to users and groups plus webhook register; no access to billing or KMS keys.
  - KMS: if your SCIM token is stored in a secrets manager, confirm HSM/KMS access audit logs for the service account.
  - MFA: console access for the scim-admin account should be MFA enforced; programmatic keys use the service account only.

Acceptance criteria we will validate in staging:
1) SSO: 5 test users can authenticate via SAML and reach the expected application role mappings.
2) SCIM: add 3 test users and 1 group; verify attributes and group membership propagate and that deletions are handled as expected.
3) Webhooks: provisioning events to our /webhook/provision reach us with 200 OK and payloads match the contract for 48 hours.

If these are green during the staging window we can schedule the prod cutover for the proposed date. I’ll attach a minimal SCIM mapping example (scim-attributes-mapping.xlsx) to this thread.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber

Couple of infra confirmations from our side: 
- We need a static egress IP for your staging SCIM endpoint or we will NAT through a static IP on our side. If you provide the NAT, we’ll accept requests from it and add to allowlist.
- Firewall health checks: please whitelist /health and /webhook endpoints so our monitoring can validate connectivity.
- Staging test account: we will create a sandbox app account (app-sandbox@redwood.com) and provide a test user set. Please confirm you are comfortable with redwood-fsc-provisioner@finserv.example.com as the account used to provision into your directory.
- CI/CD & rollbacks: we will deploy SP metadata changes to staging first; if any test fails we will auto-revert the SP config within 15 minutes to preserve user sessions.
